The surf roared in the grey mist, suddenly making his isolated tower feel profoundly small against the immense, whispering ocean.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市沉睡在浓重的青灰色薄雾中。街灯泛着昏黄而微弱的光晕，照亮空旷潮湿的沥青路面。高耸入云的大厦隐去白日的喧嚣，只剩下零星几扇窗口还亮着守夜的灯火。偶尔有一辆环卫洒水车缓缓驶过，音乐声在静谧的长街中回荡，随后便只剩树梢间早鸟试探性的低鸣。", "w03": "• Recursion is like when something is defined using a smaller version of itself, just like opening a set of Russian nesting dolls until you reach the tiny solid one inside.\n• A computer program using recursion solves a big problem by breaking it into smaller copies of the exact same problem over and over again.\n• Every recursive routine must have a stopping rule, called a base case, so it knows when the job is completely done and does not repeat forever."}
